import json, math, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
_B="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
MAT=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in _B.strip().split("\n")]
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-10**9
    pM=[NEG]*(m+1); pX=[NEG]*(m+1); pY=[NEG]*(m+1); pM[0]=0
    for j in range(1,m+1): pY[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    TB=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    for j in range(1,m+1): TB[0][j]=8
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]; row=MAT[IDX[a]] if a in IDX else None
        cM=[NEG]*(m+1); cX=[NEG]*(m+1); cY=[NEG]*(m+1); cX[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        tb=TB[i]; tb[0]=4
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            jb=IDX.get(s2[j-1]); s=row[jb] if (row is not None and jb is not None) else -1
            pm,px,py=pM[j-1]+s,pX[j-1]+s,pY[j-1]+s
            if pm>=px and pm>=py: cM[j]=pm; p=0
            elif px>=py: cM[j]=px; p=1
            else: cM[j]=py; p=2
            o1,o2=pM[j]+go,pX[j]+ge
            if o1>=o2: cX[j]=o1; q=0
            else: cX[j]=o2; q=1
            o3,o4=cM[j-1]+go,cY[j-1]+ge
            if o3>=o4: cY[j]=o3; r_=0
            else: cY[j]=o4; r_=1
            tb[j]=p|(q<<2)|(r_<<3)
        pM,pX,pY=cM,cX,cY
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([pM[m],pX[m],pY[m]])); A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1; continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1; continue
        t=TB[i][j]
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[j-1]); st=t&3; i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-'); st=0 if ((t>>2)&1)==0 else 1; i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(s2[j-1]); st=0 if ((t>>3)&1)==0 else 2; j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))
def mapidx(s1,s2):
    a1,a2=nw(s1,s2); m={}; i=j=0
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-': m[i]=(c2 if c2!='-' else None)
    return m

P=json.load(open("ortholog_panel.json"))
HS=P["Homo sapiens"]["seq"]
TETRAPODS=[k for k in P if not k.startswith("zebrafish")]
# one alignment per ortholog, reused for all 27 positions
M={}; idpct={}
for k in TETRAPODS:
    mm=mapidx(HS,P[k]["seq"]); M[k]=mm
    n=sum(1 for v in mm.values() if v); same=sum(1 for i,v in mm.items() if v==HS[i-1])
    idpct[k]=100.0*same/n
    print(f"{k:28s} {idpct[k]:5.1f}% id to human over {n} aligned")

lin=pd.read_csv("channel_lining_crossmapped.csv")
rows=[]
for _,rw in lin.iterrows():
    hp=int(rw["human_pos"])
    obs=[M[k].get(hp) for k in TETRAPODS]; obs=[o for o in obs if o]
    n=len(obs); cnt={}
    for v in obs: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    ent=-sum((c/n)*math.log(c/n,2) for c in cnt.values())
    rows.append(dict(human_pos=hp, human_aa=rw["human_aa"],
        abhd10b=f'{rw["abhd10b_aa"]}{int(rw["abhd10b_pos"])}',
        abhd10a=f'{rw["abhd10a_aa"]}{int(rw["abhd10a_pos"])}',
        dist_SerOG=float(rw["dist_SerOG"]), in_core=bool(rw["in_core"]),
        paralogs_differ=bool(rw["paralogs_differ"]),
        n_tetrapods=n, n_distinct=len(cnt), frac_major=round(max(cnt.values())/n,3),
        entropy_bits=round(ent,3),
        b_matches_tetrapod_consensus = (rw["abhd10b_aa"]==max(cnt,key=cnt.get)),
        a_matches_tetrapod_consensus = (rw["abhd10a_aa"]==max(cnt,key=cnt.get)),
        states="/".join(f"{k}{v}" for k,v in sorted(cnt.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1]))))
con=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("dist_SerOG").reset_index(drop=True)
con.to_csv("lining_conservation_tetrapods.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",60)
print("\n=== Variability at the 27 channel-lining positions across %d tetrapod orthologs ==="%len(TETRAPODS))
print(con.to_string(index=False))

D=con[con.paralogs_differ]; S=con[~con.paralogs_differ]
print(f"\ndiffering positions  n={len(D)}  mean entropy {D.entropy_bits.mean():.3f}  mean frac_major {D.frac_major.mean():.3f}  mean dist {D.dist_SerOG.mean():.2f} A")
print(f"agreeing positions   n={len(S)}  mean entropy {S.entropy_bits.mean():.3f}  mean frac_major {S.frac_major.mean():.3f}  mean dist {S.dist_SerOG.mean():.2f} A")
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(D.entropy_bits,S.entropy_bits,alternative="greater")
print(f"Mann-Whitney entropy U={u:.1f} one-sided p={pu:.4f}")
u2,pu2=stats.mannwhitneyu(D.dist_SerOG,S.dist_SerOG,alternative="greater")
print(f"Mann-Whitney distance-from-Ser U={u2:.1f} one-sided p={pu2:.4f}")
invD=int((D.n_distinct==1).sum()); invS=int((S.n_distinct==1).sum())
orr,pf=stats.fisher_exact([[invD,len(D)-invD],[invS,len(S)-invS]])
print(f"invariant across tetrapods: {invD}/{len(D)} differing vs {invS}/{len(S)} agreeing; Fisher OR={orr:.3f} p={pf:.4f}")
print(f"\nabhd10b matches tetrapod consensus at {int(con.b_matches_tetrapod_consensus.sum())}/27 lining positions")
print(f"abhd10a matches tetrapod consensus at {int(con.a_matches_tetrapod_consensus.sum())}/27 lining positions")
bd=int(D.b_matches_tetrapod_consensus.sum()); ad=int(D.a_matches_tetrapod_consensus.sum())
print(f"among the {len(D)} differing positions: abhd10b ancestral at {bd}, abhd10a ancestral at {ad}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.5))
ax[0].scatter(S.dist_SerOG,S.entropy_bits,s=80,c="#4878A8",label=f"identical in both paralogs (n={len(S)})",zorder=3,edgecolor="w")
ax[0].scatter(D.dist_SerOG,D.entropy_bits,s=130,c="#C44E52",marker="D",label=f"differs between paralogs (n={len(D)})",zorder=4,edgecolor="w")
for _,r in D.iterrows():
    ax[0].annotate(f"{r.abhd10a}→{r.abhd10b}",(r.dist_SerOG,r.entropy_bits),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(7,4),fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("distance from catalytic Ser OG in PDB 6NY9 (angstrom)")
ax[0].set_ylabel(f"amino-acid entropy across {len(TETRAPODS)} tetrapod orthologs (bits)")
ax[0].set_title("Paralog differences sit at positions that are\nalready variable among single-copy orthologs")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left"); ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

lbl=[f"{r.human_aa}{r.human_pos}" for _,r in con.iterrows()]
cols=["#C44E52" if d else "#4878A8" for d in con.paralogs_differ]
ax[1].barh(range(len(con)),con.entropy_bits,color=cols)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(con))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(lbl,fontsize=8); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel("entropy across tetrapod orthologs (bits)")
ax[1].set_title("Red: position differs between zebrafish abhd10a and abhd10b\n(human numbering, ordered by distance from catalytic Ser152)")
ax[1].grid(alpha=.3,axis="x")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
